1.

Rock, Thou who wast cleft for me, Let me hide myself in Thee. Water, blood, which forth do flow From Thy heart, O Lamb of God, Be to me a double cure Against sin and law’s dread threat.

2.

With my pious toil I ne’er Can fulfil Thy law’s demand. Were I in zeal not weary, Wept I both by night and day, Still the stains of sin remain. Only in Thee have I salvation.

3.

Naught can I give Thee. To Thy cross I cleave. Naked, Thee for clothing I entreat, Helpless, to grace I look up. Let me flee to the fountain now, Saviour, O cleanse Thou me!

4.

At each fleeting breath I draw, And when I shall die one day, When to an unknown land I go, When before Thy judgment I stand, Rock, Thou who wast cleft for me, Let me hide myself in Thee.
